entry.title: InterXion Real Estate XXII B.V. data centre in Frankfurt am Main, Germany: Emissions permit granted (BImSchG)
entry.summary: Emissions permit granted (BImSchG) on 28 Nov 2023. 64 backup generators. 459 MW of thermal input. Engine makes named: MTU, Mitsubishi. Source: UVP-Portal.
